opening.speaker: WIFE (FROM INSIDE)
opening.text: Every month is de same foolishness! Where de rent money?

opening.speaker: PROTAGONIST
opening.text: Wuhloss! I better find some money quick!

vendor.speaker: VENDOR
vendor.text: Wuh happen to you, boy? Yuh look like yuh had a rough morning!

vendor.speaker: PROTAGONIST
vendor.text: Man, muh wife call me a wutless vagabond! Tell me carry muh backside and guh find de rent money outside!

vendor.speaker: VENDOR
vendor.text: Cor blen! She really tell you all dat?

vendor.speaker: PROTAGONIST
vendor.text: And kick me clean through de door too!

vendor.speaker: VENDOR
vendor.text: Well, standing up hey en gine pay no rent. Come help me move dis crate. I gine give yuh five dollars.

vendor.speaker: PROTAGONIST
vendor.text: Five dollars?! Man, I gine be sleeping outside till Christmas!

delivery.speaker: VENDOR
delivery.text: Thank you for bringing the crate. Here is BDS $5.

delivery.speaker: VENDOR
delivery.text: Stick-fighting can help you earn money. Follow the road to the cane fields and find a suitable stick.

fight_intro.speaker: OPPONENT
fight_intro.text: We can practise a stick fight here. Use the same controls as Versus. Win three exchanges to finish this encounter.

fight_lost.speaker: OPPONENT
fight_lost.text: You can try again. Your progress and money are safe.

quest_complete.speaker: PROTAGONIST
quest_complete.text: The first fight is won. There is still rent to earn.
